newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soy products close lower on soy slide.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soy products close lower on soy slide.

text.p: CBOT soy product futures closed lower on a slide in soybeans, traders said.
Forecasts for a good harvest weekend in the U.S. Midwest plus a neutral to bearish soybean estimate from Memphis-based analytical firm Sparks Companies weighed on the market, the traders said.
The market sagged despite talk China had bought U.S. or South American soymeal.
U.S. exporters early Friday said there were indications China bought at least 50,000 tonnes of U.S. soymeal overnight for October shipment.
The exporters also indicated China this week bought 100,00 to 200,000 tonnes of U.S. soymeal.
Soyoil closed 0.18 to 0.29 cent per lb lower, with October down 0.18 at 23.32, and soymeal closed $2.50 to $4.00 per ton lower, with October down $3.70 at $244.10.
